label: Audit oversight / rotation
eligibility_rule: Regulated auditors, engagements and applicable rotation rules; client exposure differs by national rule.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Need auditor-client and engagement histories; regulator registration has no universal issuer filing date.

label: Expanded auditor reporting
eligibility_rule: US CAM fiscal-year phase, filer declaration, EGC exemption and entity exclusions; non-US KAM rules differ.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: US actual SEC annual filing dates linked; 944 linked rows remain unknown eligibility and 108 entity-class cases are withheld.

label: Beneficial ownership
eligibility_rule: Public securities-reporting issuers can be exempt; UK venue/DTR5 exemptions require exact legal listing.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: No blanket listed-equity treatment. Exempt issuer is not missing disclosure. Historical venue, reporting and subsidiary records are required.

label: Banking public CbCR
eligibility_rule: CRD credit institutions and consolidation perimeters; listed parent is distinct from bank reporter.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: 24 treated institution quote links; 3 matched full-report publishers with actual dates. Other issuer dates and reorganisations remain incomplete.

label: Confidential tax CbCR
eligibility_rule: Threshold-qualified multinational ultimate-parent groups; US prior-year revenue threshold USD850m.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Tax-authority filing is confidential. No public first-publication date exists for the confidential return. Global UPE and revenue histories absent.

label: General public tax CbCR
eligibility_rule: Large multinationals with national/EU nexus, consolidation and revenue thresholds; not the bank regime.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: FY implementation dates are not report availability. Future public reports are excluded from Table 1; no verified eligible-issuer filing cohort through 2025.

label: Climate disclosure
eligibility_rule: Country-specific listing, size, financial-sector and phased climate reporting requirements.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Climate-only is not comprehensive E/S/G. Historical tiers, fiscal years and actual first reports are not globally linked.

label: Sectoral climate reporting
eligibility_rule: Specified financial institutions; bank status does not certify climate-rule coverage.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: No supported source-corroborated issuer cohort; terminal-period support is insufficient.

label: Digital assets
eligibility_rule: Token offers, issuers and crypto-asset service providers; not every ordinary equity issuer.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Require token-offer authorisation and white-paper publication histories. Equity home-market dates alone are exposure only.

label: Comprehensive mandatory E/S/G
eligibility_rule: Mandatory response on all E, S and G topics, including comply-or-explain; phase and issuer scope required.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: 37 qualifying country phases from 41 inherited reviews. Two Irish-crosslisted eligibility examples corroborated; actual publication dates remain unknown. JCI promise is not verified publication.

label: Extractive payments
eligibility_rule: Resource-extraction issuer, project and payment thresholds; US first effective cycle differs from repealed rule.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Local 10-K ZIPs do not contain Form SD. Need sector/perimeter and actual resource-payment report filings; do not reuse conflict-minerals Form SD membership.

label: Corporate governance
eligibility_rule: Listing venue, company class and national staged size/index requirements.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Need historical listing category, rule-specific tiers and actual governance statements. Country implementation is not every issuer eligibility.

label: IFRS reporting
eligibility_rule: Regulated-market consolidated accounts, sector elections, US-GAAP exemptions and domestic options.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Need pre-adoption accounting basis, market segment, consolidation and actual first IFRS report. Firm headquarters or current name alone is insufficient.

label: Supply-chain reporting
eligibility_rule: US Rule13p1 manufacturing and necessary conflict minerals; other countries have different turnover/employee thresholds.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Apple and Intel actual 2014 filing days; Cisco 2014 filing year only, signature retained separately. Three source-selected reporters; REIT comparisons industry-screened, not a noncoverage certificate.

label: Financial sustainability disclosure
eligibility_rule: Country-specific ISSB adoption, phased listed/large-entity scope and fiscal-year requirements.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: Late panel phases and unknown first actual reports; no source-corroborated issuer test supported.

label: Informed sustainability reporting
eligibility_rule: National sector-specific sustainability framework; issuer rules must be read separately.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: No supported outcome comparison; no issuer filing date imputed from framework adoption.

label: XBRL / digital filing
eligibility_rule: US mandated phases use filer class and affirmative cover compliance; other countries include public securities and private tax filing.
filing_date_and_remaining_gap: 15 early-phase and 73 nonlarge comparison candidates; complete outcomes leave 6/62. Comparison valid through 2009 only. Compliance date is not first XBRL exhibit date.
